public_basis.source: Intrinsic Time: From the Directional-Change Scaling Laws to the source directional-change engine
public_basis.operator: online directional-change extreme tracker; no look-ahead
public_basis.threshold_basis: 0.02% is the finest threshold in the article's verified 0.02%-2% real-tick scaling-law grid
public_basis.directional_change_premise: after a confirmed directional change, the new-direction overshoot is an intrinsic-time continuation segment
public_basis.alpha_engine_premise: the article also implements the reference contrarian coastline interpretation, whose first unit is opened against the move

logic.price_stream: causal P75 midpoint from canonical bid/ask ticks
logic.initialization: track initial high and low from first Stage-A tick until first 0.02% directional move establishes mode
logic.down_change: while in up mode, confirm when midpoint falls >=0.02% from running high; reset extreme to current midpoint
logic.up_change: while in down mode, confirm when midpoint rises >=0.02% from running low; reset extreme to current midpoint
logic.event_ownership: one directional-change event at a time; operator alternates modes after each confirmation
logic.entry: event tick itself, using executable P75 ask for long / bid for short; if position busy, event is skipped rather than queued

selection_rule: advance only preregistered direction semantics passing supply/economic gates; rank strong survivors by direct net then official wins; no threshold retuning
